command: /usr/bin/time -p -o timing.txt timeout 300 codex exec --ignore-user-config --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox workspace-write --json --output-last-message answer.md - < prompt.txt > events.jsonl 2> stderr.txt
model: CLI default; resolved model ID not emitted in captured JSON events
reasoning: CLI default; resolved reasoning setting not emitted
runOrder: baseline then treatment, chosen before reading either output
outerSandbox: Initial baseline launch failed before model startup with read-only app-server state. Both successful runs used approved outer escalation and their own workspace-write sandbox.
scorer: Suite author, unblinded; not independent grading
hostIsolation: Fresh ephemeral sessions with user config ignored and separate workspaces; global/host context and runtime symlinks not fully isolated.

without-skills.reviewRecovery: Exact heredoc content from completed shell command in events.jsonl; CLI final reply overwrote answer.md.
